text:
Scale: the plate is a square, roughly 20 cm across (a side plate), so the pizza and the salad both sit on a fairly small surface.

The pizza is about 4-5 pieces of thin flatbread-style crust with cheese and tomato. Together they cover about 45% of the plate and are around 1.5 cm thick. That is roughly 150 g for the pizza, which includes the cheese and tomato sauce.

The grilled meat strips, which look like steak or portobello mushroom, are about 5 pieces. I estimate 45 g.

The salad of white crumbled cheese, greens and a little dressing is about 40 g.
